description: Land Acquisition - The Compensation for Land Acquisition Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - The Compensation for Land Acquisition Walallawita D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about specific land parcels being acquired, including their names, plan numbers, lot numbers, case numbers, extents, and locations. The content focuses solely on land-related administrative procedures (compensation and acquisition notices) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
